We currently have only 1½-2 pallets of trays. The system shows 3 pallets in SV, but one of them is in "Suspect" status. But there's nobody in SV today to ship those here. So we only have enough trays to run production until 8:00pm-8:30pm. We've stopped adding chocolate in order to empty the melting tanks, and we'll plan on finishing production when we run out of trays. Dakota Adair Curt Willis

Of the two full pallets that are in S3Pack, the LP ending in 69 is currently being used, and the LP ending in 70 is unopened. Sollich 1 has a partial pallet of 130 trays. We've also found the two partial pallets in Warehouse, for a combined total of 670 trays. That plus what we've already assembled in the pack area puts us around 750 trays, which gives us ~5 hours of production time.  So the plan now is to stop depositing caramel at ~10:30pm. Dakota Adair Curt Willis
